import numpy as np

from jf.geo import Frame


def test_round_trip_height_preserved_for_distant_aircraft():
    # A point about 100 km from the frame origin at cruise altitude.
    frame = Frame(52.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    lat, lon, h = 52.75, 1.0, 11000.0

    enu = frame.to_enu(lat, lon, h)
    lat2, lon2, h2 = frame.to_geo(enu)

    # Latitude/longitude already come back fine; the bug is the height drift.
    assert np.allclose([lat2, lon2], [lat, lon], atol=1e-10)
    assert abs(h2 - h) < 1e-3
